title: Tutorial: Visual SLAM and its challenges
description: Lecture on visual SLAM held by Oleh Basystyi, Anna Stasyshyn, and Maksym Zhuk covering SLAM basics, modern approaches, challenges (specifically, low-light and dynamic environments), and possible solutions.

title: UCU SLAM Dataset v1
description: Outdoor multi-sensor SLAM dataset recorded with our Husky A200 across the UCU campus and Stryiskyi Park in Lviv: RGB-D camera, IMU, wheel odometry, and GNSS over 13 evaluation sequences (day and twilight, loop closures, elevation changes), released in ROS 2 bag (MCAP) and TUM RGB-D formats. Note: depth streams are unusable in v1.

title: Husky UGV Build
description: Official user manual for the Clearpath Husky A200 — the UGV platform used by the UCU UGV Club. Covers hardware specifications, safety, payload integration, ROS setup, and maintenance.

title: GitHub Organization
description: All code released by the club: SLAM pipelines, navigation stacks, dataset tooling, and the source of this website.
